findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compare_investors · Private data: search_investors, get_investor, list_fields, compare_investors, get_person, get_resource, get_help, export_list, unlock_investor · Public sink: workspace_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compare_investors · Private data: search_investors, get_investor, list_fields, compare_investors, get_person, get_resource, get_help, export_list, unlock_investor · Public sink: workspace_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
